bubbles.title: Move entry points
bubbles.hint: Move src/bubble.ts, fog-gate.ts, statusline.ts into a cli folder (src/cli/ vs src/lib/cli/ to confirm). Update build output paths: SKILL.md, skill-install/agents/*, site loader, tests, then npm run build

bubbles.title: Track.ts to index.ts
bubbles.hint: Rename src/lib/track.ts -> src/lib/index.ts (the barrel). Update importers: fog-gate.ts, statusline.ts, lib/cli/{tracks,print,bubbles}.ts, site/bubble-web/machine.mts, test/track.test.js; delete stale scripts/lib/track.js on rebuild

bubbles.title: Fsync on save
bubbles.hint: src/lib/store.ts saveTrack: open tmp, write, fsyncSync, close, then rename; then fsync the dir (skip/ignore errors on Windows, dirs can't be fsynced there). Keep the tmp+rename

handoff.note: Collects every code change the human plans during the src-tour walkthrough. Add new ideas from the tour here, not on src-tour.
